infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tabi Stickers uses your camera to scan objects and create vocabulary stickers.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tabi Stickers can tag where this memory happened, turning your collection into a map of your language journey. This is entirely optional.

plugins.cameraPermission: Tabi Stickers uses your camera to scan objects and create vocabulary stickers.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: Tabi Stickers saves your stickers to your photo library so you can share them as chat stickers.

plugins.photosPermission: Tabi Stickers needs access to your photo library so you can pick a picture to turn into a sticker.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Tabi Stickers can tag where this memory happened, turning your collection into a map of your language journey. This is entirely optional.

plugins.microphonePermission: Tabi Stickers uses your microphone to record yourself practicing a word's pronunciation.
